# Overview

This analysis fits a Gaussian Graphical Model (GGM) to explore how word
predictability relates to other linguistic features.

**Key question.** Does word predictability (`mean_loss`) cluster with
phraseological, lexical, or other features?

The analysis itself lives in `_network-body.qmd`, which this notebook includes.
Two sensitivity runs under `sensitivity/` include the same file with one
predictability node held out, so all three notebooks estimate the same model on
different node sets rather than keeping three copies of the code in step. See
`sensitivity/network-no-varloss.qmd` and `sensitivity/network-no-meanloss.qmd`.

```{r}
#| label: drop-parameter
#| code-fold: false

# NULL keeps the full 15-node battery. The sensitivity notebooks set this to
# "mean_loss" or "var_loss" to hold that node out.
drop_var <- NULL
```
